scope: Current invocation: one development-task baseline. Future scoped batches may iterate autonomously within their declared limits.

fixed_conditions.null_time_semantics: No local per-task wall-clock limit; other stops remain active.

stop_rules.max_iterations_semantics: Planned model runs for this invocation, including the baseline; configure explicitly before a future batch.
stop_rules.retry_policy: No automatic retries in the current invocation; declare any future batch retry policy before execution.
stop_rules.on_api_or_environment_error: Stop and diagnose; preserve explicitly selected model, provider, task scope and budget.
stop_rules.on_quota_context_or_harness_budget_stop: Retain the incomplete attempt and count it in the declared denominator.
stop_rules.development_success: Official verifier resolves the task under the frozen conditions.
stop_rules.generalization_claim: Requires a predeclared comparison on additional tasks; one tuned task is insufficient.

notes: Copy this template into ignored run storage. Preserve completed snapshots and all failures. Do not include secrets, reference fixes or restricted task contents in public records.
